contract_gaps.operation_security: The current official OpenAPI omits operation security metadata for validateShopperId, 38 late-added Balance Platform operations, and cashouts. The official API-level documentation still requires X-API-Key, so those buildable routes remain admitted and connection-owned.
contract_gaps.request_body_requiredness: The official OpenAPI omits requestBody.required on most mutations while their referenced schemas declare required fields. The generator enumerates provider-required schema leaves for non-GET JSON bodies and does not invent values.
contract_gaps.dynamic_sca: Optional WWW-Authenticate SCA headers are not caller arguments and may require an out-of-band SCA-capable integration. The two scaAssociations mutations where that header is required are excluded.
